Machine Learning Engineer

Berlin, Germany · Hybrid · Full-time

Proseware builds document intelligence for insurance companies. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to take models from research to production.

About the role

You will own model training pipelines and the services that serve predictions to customers.

Responsibilities

  • Train and evaluate NLP models with PyTorch
  • Deploy models behind low-latency APIs
  • Monitor model quality and data drift

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in ML engineering
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills
  • Experience with Docker and a major cloud

Benefits

30 days of vacation, learning budget, and a public transport ticket.
